definitions.gloss: bird's nest; a nest built by a bird for laying eggs and raising chicks
definitions.explanation: A structure made by a bird from twigs, grass, mud, and other materials to hold eggs and shelter young birds. Also used figuratively for tangled, messy hair.

examples.english: There's a bird's nest in the tree.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}の{巣|す}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There were three eggs in the bird's nest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ツバメ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軒下|のきした}→軒下：07850_nokishita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鳥|とり}の{巣|す}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, swallows build nests under the eaves.

notes:
Literally "⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧ (bird) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (possessive) + ⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧ (nest)." A basic compound for one of the most common natural objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥|とり}の{巣|す}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to build a bird's nest
- {鳥|とり}の{巣|す}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧: to find a bird's nest
- {鳥|とり}の{巣|す}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: hair like a bird's nest (tangled, messy)
- {鳥|とり}の{巣|す}{箱|ばこ}: nesting box, birdhouse

USAGE:
{鳥|とり}の{巣|す}⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧な⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ ("hair like a bird's nest") describes extremely tangled, unkempt hair — the same metaphor exists in English.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧: nest — the general word for any animal's home or dwelling place
- ⟦{巣箱|すばこ}→巣箱：26028_subako⟧: nesting box, birdhouse — an artificial nest provided for birds
- ⟦{蜂|はち}の{巣|す}→蜂の巣：24336_hachinosu⟧: beehive/wasp nest — a nest made by bees or wasps
- ⟦{巣穴|すあな}→巣穴：24340_suana⟧: burrow, den — an underground animal dwelling
